posts.title_zh: 新品上市：便携式折叠太阳能板
posts.body_en:
Two new waterproof, splash-resistant folding solar panels are now available: a multi-fold panel with a stand, higher power options and custom LOGO printing, and a compact double-fold panel with a full set of adapters.
Great for camping, vehicles, RVs, the wild and power outages. Contact us on WhatsApp for prices.
posts.body_zh:
两款防水防泼溅折叠太阳能板全新上市：多折款带支架，功率可选更大，可印LOGO；双折款小巧轻便，配件齐全，带多种转接头。
适用于露营、车载、房车、野外及停电应急。欢迎通过 WhatsApp 咨询价格。
